book_title: Nick of Time (The Gunn Files, Book 4)
book_topic: Noir detective fiction meets humorous science fiction in the Gunn Files series
personalization_detail: Nick of Time, Book 4 of The Gunn Files, was published April 14, 2025; he is based in Austin, Texas.
personalization_reason: Verified on Amazon, Barnes & Noble and FictionDB listings plus mgherron.com contact and policy pages.
personalized_opening: I noticed Nick of Time, the fourth Gunn Files book, arrived in April 2025, and the blend of noir detective storytelling with the humor of Scalzi and Douglas Adams is a fun combination. Your space opera work, including the Ruins anthology, shows how wide your range is.
email_body:
Hi Matt,

I noticed Nick of Time, the fourth Gunn Files book, arrived in April 2025, and the blend of noir detective storytelling with the humor of Scalzi and Douglas Adams is a fun combination. Your space opera work, including the Ruins anthology, shows how wide your range is.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. The feature is designed to introduce readers to your work, the story behind your book, and the experiences or ideas that have shaped your journey as an author. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

One option I believe could suit Nick of Time is a short cinematic trailer with a few promotional reels. If a trailer for the book is something you have been considering, we can handle the full production. It is entirely optional and separate from the Spotlight.

The Author Spotlight is a paid feature, and I would be happy to share the details and pricing if it sounds like a good fit.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit Nick of Time (The Gunn Files, Book 4) best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
